en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view of a town with scattered low buildings on gently rolling hills, backed by arid mountains. In the foreground there is a dense grove of palm trees. Beneath the photograph, printed captions in Portuguese and French identify the scene as a partial view of the city of Praia in Cabo Verde / Cap‑Vert. A small serial number appears at the bottom left.
